notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
Aura of Dominion attached to Tawnos.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Workhorse from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Workhorse.
Activate the Workhorse token three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the Workhorse token, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Workhorse token and causing you to mill two cards .
Repeat from step 2.
